spells.targets: One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect.
spells.duration: Instantaneous sensation; pending distraction until consumed or its one-round endpoint. Ends at the end of the target's first future regular turn, excluding the entire current target turn if one is already in progress. Outside initiative, expires 6 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the selected virtual marker or absolute deadline through initiative changes and absence; end-phase effects resolve before end-marker cleanup.
spells.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC. Success: no new sensation or rider. Failure: it experiences a convincing subjective surge of relief or apparent recovery and receives disadvantage on its next actual Perception check before the endpoint. Consume the rider when that check begins, even if another source already imposes disadvantage or advantage cancels it.
spells.effect: The sensation can feel like warmth, easing pain or the beginning of healing. It restores no HP or temporary HP, stabilizes nothing, removes no Wound or condition and generates no healing/recovery event or trigger. Apparent comfort does not alter actual injury, damage, HP-dependent rules or knowledge made apparent by physical evidence. The target is never required to behave as though mechanically healed. One pending False Comfort distraction per target across all casters; a later failed save replaces it, while a later successful save leaves an existing rider intact.
spells.scaling: None. No automatic increase in damage, range, duration, targets, uses or information.
spells.limitations: The one-use rider names an actual Perception check; it does not independently lower passive Perception or require a new check. No Action/turn loss, forced movement, belief about a specific medical fact, magical diagnosis, cure, enduring pain suppression or permanent memory change is granted. If no qualifying check occurs before expiry, the rider ends unused. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot erase it. A failed or countered new cast creates no replacement, though independently required concentration/contact endings still occur. Actual class access, repertoire, components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base 0 RP does not waive Action/components or Refrain. A failed, blocked or countered cast refunds no committed cost and restores no old concentration. V is audible and S needs its normal usable hand; subtle names do not hide casting. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC, with ordinary binary save rules. Creature type alone grants no mental immunity. Actual mental/Enchantment/other defenses apply only within their written scope; immunity only to Charmed does not automatically block a spell that never imposes Charmed. No automatic cantrip scaling.
spells.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V,S and apparent healing with no actual healing effect. NEW: WIS save, fleeting relief and one-Perception-check distraction lasting one target round. The Healing tag supplies no healing trigger; the numeric distraction is an explicit reviewed addition.
